note: Source registry of the data layer (docs/data/inventory.md). Collectors, the deploy script, the health report and the monitor read it; packages/data/tests/ingestion/test_sources.py keeps it, the systemd units and the monitor consistent. status: enabled | trial | disabled | planned (only enabled and trial are run and checked). tier: 1 = mail at once (data correctness, or attribution as a whole fails); 2 = in the daily summary only; 3 = logged only. expected_hours: the usual interval between completed requests (null = judged otherwise, or on demand). key: the health report's source key in that store (fnmatch pattern). since: when the source went live on the server (a missing store or a source without ledger rows is not a problem before since + the silent limit). time_reference: an independent source for the publication time (required for every active source of category news, press_release or sec).
